description: Seed commits for the `commitlore guard` suite. The `redis-cache` record is the commit message from bench/tasks/reproposal-redis-cache.yaml verbatim, so the unit suite and the AnnalsBench re-encounter task (T-701/T-702) measure the same rejection. The other records pin properties bench cannot exercise from a single arm: path scope, the lifecycle fold, the `--at` replay, and issue #61's real filename-only false positive. `precisionRecords` is seeded into its own repository — it is the `direct-pool` record from bench/tasks/reproposal-prisma-orm.yaml, whose rejected alternative is mostly generic vocabulary, and it exists to measure the *near* miss rather than the far one. File bodies are stubs — guard reads trailers and the commit's touched paths, never file contents; the bench tasks own the real sources.

records.message:
Use an in-process map for the session cache

The session payload is small enough that a per-process map beats a
network hop, and it keeps the deployment to a single artifact.

Limit: the v1 runtime has no network egress to hosts outside the app subnet
Ruled-out: shared Redis cache | ops refuses another stateful dependency for
  a v1, and the session payload is under 4KB
Ruled-out: memcached sidecar | same operational objection, and it loses the
  persistence story that made a shared cache attractive
Warn: session entries must stay under 4KB or the eviction math stops holding
